message: I was just charged twice for my Pro subscription this month — $49 came out twice from my card on the same day. Can someone refund the duplicate charge? This is affecting my business account balance.
Love the new dashboard redesign! Any chance you're planning to add a dark mode option in a future release? Not urgent, just curious.
Your entire platform has been down for the last 20 minutes — none of my team can log in and we have a client demo in an hour. Please escalate immediately.
When I export a report to CSV, the date column shows the wrong format (MM/DD instead of DD/MM like the rest of my account settings). Not blocking, but annoying.
Could you point me to documentation on how to set up SSO for our organization? We're evaluating rolling it out next quarter.
I'm locked out of my account after too many failed login attempts and I have a board meeting in 30 minutes where I need to pull up our analytics. Please help urgently.

I just got an email that looks like it's from your company asking me to 'reverify my payment info' with a link to a site that isn't your domain. I think someone is phishing your customers using your branding.
Our Zapier integration stopped firing webhooks for new orders sometime yesterday. It was working fine last week. Can someone check if anything changed on your end?
We're a team of 40 evaluating your Enterprise plan. Can someone walk us through pricing and whether you offer annual billing discounts?
Just wanted to say your support team has been fantastic this year — no issue, just a thank you!
Can you send me an itemized invoice for last month? I need it for our expense reporting and the one in the portal doesn't break down the add-ons separately.
The app crashes every single time I try to save a form with more than 10 line items. I've lost work twice today because of this and there's no workaround I can find.
I need to reset my password but the reset email never arrives, even after 3 tries and checking spam. I have a client presentation tomorrow morning and need access tonight.
Is there a keyboard shortcut to duplicate a row in the spreadsheet view? Just trying to speed up my workflow, no rush.
Our finance team needs a CSV export of the monthly billing summary for our audit next week — right now I can only see it on-screen. Could this be prioritized? It's blocking our audit prep.
One of our employees clicked a suspicious link and their account showed a login from an unfamiliar country an hour later. We haven't confirmed a breach yet but wanted to flag it immediately.
The reporting dashboard has been throwing a 500 error for about 15 minutes for our whole team, but the rest of the app seems to work fine.

Our production order-sync integration has been completely broken since this morning — no orders are flowing from your platform into our warehouse system, and we're now shipping blind. This is costing us real money every hour.
I upgraded to the Pro plan last week but I'm still seeing the free-tier usage limits in my account. Did the upgrade not go through?
It's not working. Please help.
